600+ TB/day processed, World Mobile's own reporting, Feb 2026. ** THIS IS A THROUGHPUT, NOT A UTILISATION. ** It is stored under utilisation_pct with its label, its UNIT and its comparability all overridden in config.py — the unit override is what stops the cell rendering 60,000%, because utilisation_pct is a fraction everywhere else. The cell renders AMBER as non-comparable. A true utilisation needs network capacity as a denominator and nothing on file provides one. A FLOOR: the '+' is dropped.

MONTHLY Net Protocol Surplus for May 2026, Sky Frontier Foundation's own monthly reporting (insights.skyeco.com). MONTHLY IS THE ONLY GRANULARITY STORED FOR THIS METRIC — Stage 2 states its shares as percentages of MONTHLY NPS, and Sky publishes quarterly figures that ALREADY CONTAIN these months. Storing both put May + June + Q2 into one 90-day window: $53.81m against a true $33.29m, 62% over. The quarterly and FY figures are now references in config.py Sky.net_protocol_surplus_reference, and the months are checked against them (period_reconciliation). Dated to month-end.

MONTHLY Net Protocol Surplus for June 2026, Sky Frontier Foundation's own monthly reporting (insights.skyeco.com). See the May row for why only monthly values are stored. NOTE THE DATE: June month-end and Q2 2026 quarter-end are the same calendar day, and the store keys on (date, project, metric) — so these two figures could never have coexisted in the series, which is the mechanical half of the same reason. APRIL 2026 IS NOT HERE: $12.77m is DERIVED (33.29 - 9.71 - 10.81), not published, and storing a derived value as a flow would make the quarter reconcile against itself.
